meta.topupRule: A+: target = floor(100 a (b / a)^u) / 100, u uniform [0, 1) on 52 bits of crypto.getRandomValues, [a, b) = [1000, 10000), or exactly 10,000 (round i in block i mod 2)

clientSeedGenerator.A: "audit" + 6 bytes of crypto.getRandomValues as hex (browser CSPRNG)
clientSeedGenerator.D: "pfaudit-prod-limbo-d<k>-" + 6 bytes of crypto.getRandomValues as hex, k = 1..5, one per Phase D epoch, drawn when the plan is built (written into the meta before the anchor rotation), submitted at the rotation that opens that epoch

conversion.api: originals (/api/v1/originals/limbo/place-bet and /verify), every round of every capture
conversion.order: captures in the order of convert/inputs.limbo.json (the order they were played); inside a capture, the file order of its bet events. Epochs are renumbered 0..N-1 across the captures in that order; seeds[].captureEpoch is the epoch number inside its own capture file
conversion.seedRecords: one per epoch: clientSeed, hashedServerSeed, nextHashedServerSeed, nonceStart from the rotation reply that opened the epoch (the first epoch of a capture: the rotation that closed that capture's pre-capture pair), serverSeed from the rotation reply that closed it; at = that opening rotation; nonceEnd = the last nonce recorded in the epoch; commitVerified = sha256(serverSeed) === hashedServerSeed and chainLinkOk = nextHashedServerSeed === the hash the closing rotation made active, both recomputed by the converter; capture, captureEpoch, phase, phaseId, seedTag (player = a Phase D player-set seed, audit = the runner's per-epoch seed), plannedBets, stake = the runner's epoch event (the 7 Nov capture's epoch events carry no stake: its meta stake)
conversion.captures: meta.captures[i]: the source file and its sha256, the runner build, the plan summary, the first / last epoch and the bet count it contributes, its window, and its own pre-capture anchor (the pair active before its first round and the rotation that revealed it; commitVerified recomputed). The three captures are three separate runs on the same account: the seed chain is asserted inside each capture, not across them

bets.served: id = betId; params.target = servedParams.target; nonce, clientSeed, serverSeedId, hashedServerSeed (= serverSeedHash) as served; result, win, multiplier = the served outcome; resultLabel = the served wager result; betAmount / winningAmount / stakeWallet / winningAmountWallet = the served strings, unchanged
bets.recorded: at, phase, phaseId = the runner's record of the round (the 7 Nov capture has no phase id: all its rounds are Phase A, phaseId A); capture = 1-based index into meta.captures; epoch = renumbered as above
bets.verifier: the capture's verify event of the same round (same betId, epoch and nonce; exactly one HTTP 200 reply per round): date = the reply's Date header; request = the body the runner POSTed to /api/v1/originals/limbo/verify (serverSeed, clientSeed, nonce, params.target); echo = the reply's seeds and derivationParams; result, win, multiplier = the reply's outcome. Parsed with JSON.parse, not recomputed

recomputed.verified: localResult === served result && localWin === served win (exact)

conversion.phases: meta.phases[letter]: bets and epochs counted from the capture files, stake = the served stake string of every round of the phase (one value, or the converter stops), amount = Number(stake), ids = bets per plan entry (A: A = the 50-target ladder of 7 Nov, A+ = the top-up of 10 Nov), epochSizes = the distinct plannedBets of its epochs
conversion.plan: meta.ladder = the 50 targets of the 7 Nov plan (its meta.targets) and of Phase D (the 10 Nov meta.ladder100), required identical; meta.targetRule, meta.topupRule = the runners' own descriptions; meta.clientSeedGenerator = the runners' own descriptions per seed tag
